reason: The GET /fruits/:id handler at test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6:226-228 ignores the id and always returns fruits[0] (apple, color_ids [1,2]). The patched 'find embedded' test asks for store.find('fruit', 2) but expects colors [1,2], which belong to apple; banana's color_ids are [3]. So the test passes only because the handler returns the wrong record.
